<div class="paper-filter-panel" aria-label="Publication filters">
<div class="paper-filter-heading"><div><span class="filter-eyebrow">Explore the publication list</span><h2>Filter papers</h2></div><button type="button" class="filter-reset" id="paper-filter-reset">Reset filters</button></div>
<label class="paper-search"><span>Search</span><input type="search" id="paper-search" placeholder="Title, author, venue, or topic" autocomplete="off"></label>
<div class="filter-group" data-filter-group="year"><span class="filter-label">Year</span><button type="button" class="filter-chip active" data-filter-value="all">All</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="2026">2026</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="2025">2025</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="2024">2024</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="2023">2023</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="2022">2022</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="2021">2021</button></div>
<div class="filter-group" data-filter-group="venue"><span class="filter-label">Venue</span><button type="button" class="filter-chip active" data-filter-value="all">All</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="ACL">ACL</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="IEEE Big Data">IEEE Big Data</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="ACM Web Conference">ACM Web Conference</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="ECML PKDD">ECML PKDD</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="PAKDD">PAKDD</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="IJCNN">IJCNN</button></div>
<div class="filter-group" data-filter-group="topic"><span class="filter-label">Topic</span><button type="button" class="filter-chip active" data-filter-value="all">All</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="Knowledge Graphs">Knowledge Graphs</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="Large Language Models">Large Language Models</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="Biomedical NLP">Biomedical NLP</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="Anomaly Detection">Anomaly Detection</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="Backdoor Attacks">Backdoor Attacks</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="Explainable AI">Explainable AI</button><button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-filter-value="Trustworthy AI">Trustworthy AI</button></div>
<div class="paper-result-count" id="paper-result-count" aria-live="polite">8 papers</div>
</div>

## Peer-reviewed conference papers

::: {#peer-reviewed}
:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const state = { year: "all", venue: "all", topic: "all", search: "" };
  const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".pub-item"));
  const count = document.getElementById("paper-result-count");
  const search = document.getElementById("paper-search");

  const applyFilters = () => {
    let visible = 0;
    items.forEach((item) => {
      const topics = (item.dataset.topics || "").split("|");
      const matches =
        (state.year === "all" || item.dataset.year === state.year) &&
        (state.venue === "all" || item.dataset.venue === state.venue) &&
        (state.topic === "all" || topics.includes(state.topic)) &&
        (!state.search || item.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(state.search));
      item.hidden = !matches;
      if (matches) visible += 1;
    });
    count.textContent = `${visible} ${visible === 1 ? "paper" : "papers"}`;
  };

  document.querySelectorAll(".filter-group").forEach((group) => {
    group.querySelectorAll(".filter-chip").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        group.querySelectorAll(".filter-chip").forEach((chip) => chip.classList.remove("active"));
        button.classList.add("active");
        state[group.dataset.filterGroup] = button.dataset.filterValue;
        applyFilters();
      });
    });
  });

  search.addEventListener("input", () => {
    state.search = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    applyFilters();
  });

  document.getElementById("paper-filter-reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    state.year = state.venue = state.topic = "all";
    state.search = "";
    search.value = "";
    document.querySelectorAll(".filter-group").forEach((group) => {
      group.querySelectorAll(".filter-chip").forEach((chip) => {
        chip.classList.toggle("active", chip.dataset.filterValue === "all");
      });
    });
    applyFilters();
  });
});
</script>
